name: spec
description: Spec pipeline v7 — a small code program run by a trusted engineer, verified by executed evidence. Lifecycle: /spec:genesis (greenfield) → roadmap briefs → /spec:mocks → /spec:plan → /spec:run (build, then review, each driver-stepped with one fresh-context reviewer and a derived verdict) → /spec:release; plus /spec:status, /spec:doctor, /spec:enforce, /spec:fix. Changelog (last 3): 7.297.0 — review legs reuse a whole-suite gate as the suite leg — gateRunsSuite in lib/gate-resolve.js proves the host gate already ran the full test command (no {testDirs}/{scopeDirs}, a && segment equal to testCommand), so review-legs and --mark closed skip the redundant suite run; a scoped gate behaves as before, and every legs run now records wall-clock milliseconds per leg. 7.296.0 — the host declares its file shapes: grounding contract gains the optional fileShapes block (testGlobs, codeExtensions, manifests over stack-neutral defaults in lib/file-shapes.js); every script classifies tests, code and manifests through it; /spec:init profiles and writes the block and /spec:doctor check 1 proves each declared test glob with init-gen shapes-check. 7.295.0 — grounding contract gains the optional testCaseScanner key: a host command listing its own test cases (<file> :: <title> or JSON with start/end) so non-JavaScript stacks resolve, count and expire cases; /spec:init profiles the runner's case shape and /spec:doctor proves the listing with count-tests --scanner-check.
